name: Wuxi Hyatech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Hyatech Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, research, develops, manufactures, and sells aero-engines and gas turbine components; and medical orthopedic implant forgings in China and internationally. The company offers compressor blades; rotating and structural parts, including rectifiers, casing, turbine, compressor, and bladed disks; and other products. It also provides medical orthopedic implant forgings for artificial hip joints, femoral stems, acetabular cups, artificial knee joints, tibial trays, and artificial trauma bone plates. The company serves aero engine and medical orthopedic joint manufacturers. Wuxi Hyatech Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2013 and is based in Wuxi, China.
